command:
set -euo pipefail
LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html
MOD=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/idle_face.js
TMP=/tmp/frankenstein_idle_face_v1.$$.js
EXP=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
echo SERVICE_BEFORE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo WINDOWS_BEFORE
DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -lxG 2>/dev/null | grep -F 'FranKenstein -- live' || true
GOT=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo BEFORE_SHA=$GOT
[ "$GOT" = "$EXP" ] || { echo CAS_MISMATCH; exit 23; }
gh api 'repos/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity/contents/local_bridge/payloads/avatar_idle_face_v1.js?ref=chatgpt-local-ai-core-node-control' --jq .content | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d > "$TMP"
grep -q 'IDLE FACE v1' "$TMP" || { echo PAYLOAD_MARKER_MISSING; exit 24; }
node --check "$TMP"
echo FETCHED_PAYLOAD_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 - "$LIVE" "$MOD" "$TMP" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, os, sys
live, mod, src = map(Path, sys.argv[1:4])
text=live.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
anchor='  <script src="/filmlook.js"></script>'
insert='  <script src="/idle_face.js"></script>\n'+anchor
if '/idle_face.js' in text: raise SystemExit('IDLE_INCLUDE_ALREADY_PRESENT')
if text.count(anchor)!=1: raise SystemExit('FILMLOOK_ANCHOR_COUNT='+str(text.count(anchor)))
backup=live.parent/'.go_evidence'/'idle_face_v1_pre_buehne.html'
backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); backup.write_bytes(live.read_bytes())
mtmp=mod.with_name('.idle_face.js.tmp'); mtmp.write_bytes(src.read_bytes()); os.replace(mtmp,mod)
new=text.replace(anchor,insert,1); htmp=live.with_name('.buehne.html.idle-face-v1.tmp'); htmp.write_text(new,encoding='utf-8'); os.replace(htmp,live)
print('PAYLOAD_SHA='+hashlib.sha256(mod.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('AFTER_SHA='+hashlib.sha256(live.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('BACKUP_SHA='+hashlib.sha256(backup.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY
echo HTTP_INCLUDE=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/ | grep -c '/idle_face.js')
echo HTTP_PAYLOAD_MARKER=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/idle_face.js | grep -c 'IDLE FACE v1')
sleep 5
echo SERVICE_AFTER=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo WINDOWS_AFTER
DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -lxG 2>/dev/null | grep -F 'FranKenstein -- live' || true
echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo MOD_SHA=$(sha256sum "$MOD" | awk '{print $1}')
